z5l1_v4_a.text: Everyone goes away. Everyone goes away.

z5s4_a.text: Come and find me. Nobody ever comes.

z5s4_b.text: Come and find me. Nobody ever comes.

z5s4_v4_a.text: Come and find me. Nobody ever comes.

ma5vm_a.text: Boy, why you never pick up? Ma worried, you know. Call me back, okay?

ma5vm_b.text: Boy, why you never pick up? Ma worried, you know. Call me back, okay?

mk5teach_a.text: Give without bargaining. Keep your precepts. Then dedicate the merit. That is what you can do for them.

mk5teach_b.text: Give without bargaining. Keep your precepts. Then dedicate the merit. That is what you can do for them.

ow5careful_a.text: Look after them like your owner, but don't play play with them.

ow5careful_b.text: Look after them like your own, but don't play play with them.

ow5give_a.text: So think of them like small children with nowhere to go. You give them drink, you make merit for them. You are giving them something they never had.

ow5give_b.text: So think of them like small children with nowhere to go. You give them drink. You make merit for them. You are giving them something they never had.

ow5hello_a.text: Ah, you came. Come, come. I want you to meet three small ones.

ow5hello_b.text: Ah, you came. Come, come. I want you to meet three small ones.

ow5little_a.text: And this small one. Somebody left him at a temple gate. Nobody knows where he came from.

ow5little_b.text: And this small one. Somebody left him at a temple gate. Nobody knows where he came from.

ow5monk_a.text: Small ones who passed on young with nowhere to go yet. Nobody forces them to stay. They come of their own free will. They help a kind person a little and they can't make merit for themselves. So you make it and you give it to them. We believe it helps them on toward a better birth.

ow5monk_b.text: Small ones who passed on young, with nowhere to go yet. Nobody forces them to stay. They come of their own free will. They help a kind person, a little. And they can't make merit for themselves. So you make it, and you give it to them. We believe it helps them on, toward a better birth.

ow5never_a.text: But listener, never keep them for greed. Not for money, not for lottery numbers. If that is why you want them, don't take them.

ow5never_b.text: But listener, never keep them for greed. Not for money. Not for lottery numbers. If that is why you want them, don't take them.

ow5promise_a.text: And not for one month, not for one year. Every day you look after them. You keep making merit for them. As long as you live. If one day you really cannot, you bring them back to me or to a temple. Never just leave them. Can or not?

ow5promise_b.text: And not for one month, not for one year. Every day you look after them, you keep making merit for them, as long as you live. If one day you really cannot, you bring them back to me or to a temple. Never just leave them. Can or not,

ow5red_a.text: This one, a family took him home for luck. When the luck didn't come fast enough, they brought him back. Didn't want him anymore.

ow5red_b.text: This one, a family took him home for luck. When the luck didn't come fast enough, they brought him back, didn't want him anymore.

ow5shy_a.text: This one, an old auntie looked after him for 20 years. When she passed on, her family brought him back to me, with her music box.

ow5shy_b.text: This one, an old auntie looked after him for 20 years. When she passed on, her family brought him back to me with her music box.

ow5wrong_a.text: And never ask them to do anything wrong. The ones from a temple, we believe, won't help you do wrong. Children grow like the one who raises them. So you keep the precept yourself.

ow5wrong_b.text: And never ask them to do anything wrong. The ones from a temple we believe won't help you do wrong. Children grow like the one who raises them. So you keep the precepts yourself.

ow5yin_a.text: Children? Yes. Ghosts to be afraid of? No. What you're thinking of? Trapped with black magic, fed with blood, sent to hurt people? That's something else. These three came from a temple. A Luang Phor gave them a home there, out of compassion.

ow5yin_b.text: Children, yes. Ghosts to be afraid of, no. What you're thinking of, trapped with black magic, fed with blood, sent to hurt people, that's something else. These three came from a temple. A Luang Phor gave them a home there, out of compassion.

z5A1_a.text: He asked me to stay. Tomorrow night, I will.

z5A1_b.text: He asked me to stay. Tomorrow night, I will.

z5A2_a.text: Every night it was easier to go.

z5A2_b.text: Every night, it was easier to go.

z5A5_a.text: I stopped being sure where they ended and where I began.

z5A5_b.text: I stopped being sure where they ended and where I began.

z5A6_a.text: They needed someone to look after them, and I couldn't do it anymore.

z5A6_b.text: They needed someone to look after them. And I couldn't do it anymore.

z5A_a.text: I promised to look after them. In the end, there was no one left to do it.

z5A_b.text: I promised to look after them. In the end, there was no one left to do it.

z5B1_a.text: Nobody would believe this unless I told them.

z5B1_b.text: Nobody would believe this unless I told them.

z5B2_a.text: I wrote it all down. Every child. Every voice.

z5B2_b.text: I wrote it all down. Every child. Every voice.

z5B4_a.text: Someone had tried it. Because of me. And I didn't know what to tell them.

z5B4_b.text: Someone had tried it. Because of me. And I didn't know what to tell them.

z5B5_a.text: The shy one hid from everyone, and I showed him to everyone.

z5B5_b.text: The shy one hid from everyone, and I showed him to everyone.

z5B6_a.text: I wanted someone to believe me. Instead, I made them a horror story and showed strangers the way in.

z5B6_b.text: I wanted someone to believe me. Instead, I made them a horror story and showed strangers the way in.

z5B_a.text: They were children, not a horror story. I showed strangers the way in.

z5B_b.text: They were children, not a horror story. I showed strangers the way in.

z5C1_a.text: If they're real, then they can help me.

z5C1_b.text: If they're real, then they can help me.

z5C2_a.text: Bring me look. Bring me orders. Please.

z5C2_b.text: Bring me luck. Bring me orders. Please.

z5C3_a.text: The orders came. Maybe it was them. Maybe it wasn't. I didn't care. I only wanted more.

z5C3_b.text: The orders came. Maybe it was them. Maybe it wasn't. I didn't care. I only wanted more.

z5C4_a.text: More orders. More money. A bigger place. A little more luck. Just a little more.

z5C4_b.text: More orders. More money. A bigger place. A little more luck. Just a little more.

z5C5_a.text: If I stop asking, will it all go away?

z5C5_b.text: If I stop asking, will it all go away?

z5C6_a.text: They were only children, and I had turned them into a wishing well.

z5C6_b.text: They were only children, and I had turned them into a wishing well.

z5C7_a.text: Nothing answered. They wouldn't do wrong, even when I asked them to.

z5C7_b.text: Nothing answered. They wouldn't do wrong, even when I asked them to.

z5C_a.text: I stopped giving to them. I only kept asking.

z5C_b.text: I stopped giving to them. I only kept asking.

z5Cevil_a.text: And him make him lose everything.

z5Cevil_b.text: And him. Make him lose everything.

z5D1_a.text: I'm sorry. That was my mistake, not yours.

z5D1_b.text: I'm sorry. That was my mistake. Not yours.

z5D2_a.text: I won't open that door again. But I'm not going anywhere.

z5D2_b.text: I won't open that door again, but I'm not going anywhere.

z5D3_a.text: In the morning I went to the temple and made merit in their names.

z5D3_b.text: In the morning I went to the temple and made merit in their names.

z5D4_a.text: For the three children in my care, may this merit reach you. May you be well, and one day, may you go on to a better birth.

z5D4_b.text: For the three children in my care, may this merit reach you, may you be well, and one day may you go on to a better birth.

z5D5_a.text: I kept caring for them every day and making merit in their names for years. And I never opened that door again.

z5D5_b.text: I kept caring for them every day, and making merit in their names for years, and I never opened that door again.

z5D6_a.text: If one day I can't look after them, someone will. I made sure of it.

z5D6_b.text: If one day I can't look after them, someone will. I made sure of it.

z5D_a.text: I kept my promise every day, and I kept my own door shut.

z5D_b.text: I kept my promise every day, and I kept my own door shut.

z5ask_a.text: What would happen if I deliberately opened myself to my own Kumanthong?

z5ask_b.text: What would happen if I deliberately opened myself to my own Kumanthong?

z5back1_a.text: That wasn't me. That was him.

z5back1_b.text: That wasn't me. That was him.

z5back1b_a.text: He wasn't angry. He just wanted someone to want him.

z5back1b_b.text: He wasn't angry. He just wanted someone to want him.

z5back2b_a.text: I was hiding under my own desk, waiting for someone to find me.

z5back2b_b.text: I was hiding under my own desk, waiting for someone to find me.

z5bag_a.text: Three red drinks. Three straws. Same as every night since the day I promised.

z5bag_b.text: Three red drinks. Three straws. Same as every night, since the day I promised.

z5come_a.text: I'm sorry. I have to go back.

z5come_b.text: I'm sorry. I have to go back.

z5dedic_a.text: May the merit I make reach you three. And one day, may you go on to a better birth.

z5dedic_b.text: May the merit I make reach you three. And one day, may you go on to a better birth.

z5eat_a.text: Come. Eat. This is for you three.

z5eat_b.text: Come. Eat. This is for you three.

z5epi0_a.text: They were never something to fear, only children with nowhere to go, and what they needed from me was care, merit, and kindness for as long as I live.

z5epi0_b.text: They were never something to fear, only children with nowhere to go, and what they needed from me was care, merit, and kindness, for as long as I live.

z5epi1_a.text: Looking back today, I can see clearly how dangerous and how completely unnecessary that experiment was.

z5epi1_b.text: Looking back today, I can see clearly how dangerous and how completely unnecessary that experiment was.

z5epi2_a.text: Some lessons are only learned by living them.

z5epi2_b.text: Some lessons are only learned by living them.

z5epi3_a.text: This is the one experiment I would tell everybody never to repeat.

z5epi3_b.text: This is the one experiment I would tell everybody never to repeat.

z5fasc_a.text: And at that moment, I was fascinated by it.

z5fasc_b.text: And at that moment, I was fascinated by it.

z5felt_a.text: To be wanted. To be found. To not be left alone. That's all they ever wanted.

z5felt_b.text: To be wanted. To be found. To not be left alone. That's all they ever wanted.

z5l1_v4_b.text: Everyone goes away. Everyone goes away.

z5l2_v4_a.text: You won't go. You won't go, right?

z5little_a.text: And this one's for you, little one.

z5little_b.text: And this one's for you, little one.

z5out_a.text: His incense had burnt out, but he held on to me. He didn't want to be left alone again.

z5out_b.text: His incense had burnt out. But he held on to me. He didn't want to be left alone again.

z5pro1_a.text: While I was still searching for answers, I began keeping Kumanthong.

z5pro1_b.text: While I was still searching for answers, I began keeping Kumanthong.

z5pro2_a.text: I saw it as another way of making merit and showing compassion.

z5pro2_b.text: I saw it as another way of making merit and showing compassion.

z5pro3_a.text: So I took them home, and made offerings to them, every day.

z5pro3_b.text: So I took them home and made offerings to them every day.

z5pro4_a.text: Then one night, after everything else I had been through, I wanted to know something.

z5pro4_b.text: Then one night, after everything else I had been through, I wanted to know something.

z5red_a.text: There you go, big boss. Your favorite.

z5red_b.text: There you go, big boss. Your favorite.

z5s3_v4_a.text: Mine. My secret. Mine. My secret.

z5s3_v4_b.text: Mine. Mine. Mine. Mine. My secret.

z5s4_v4_b.text: Come and find me. Nobody ever comes.

z5shy_a.text: This one's yours. Don't be shy.

z5shy_b.text: This one's yours. Don't be shy.

z5water_a.text: Water first. Never let it run dry.

z5water_b.text: Water first. Never let it run dry.

z5wonder_a.text: Every night they just sit here. I wonder what they feel.

z5wonder_b.text: Every night they just sit here. I wonder what they feel.

z5yinq_a.text: Uncle. Aren't these yin? Baby ghosts. The kind people trap with black magic, feed with blood, that turn on you if you ever stop.

z5yinq_b.text: Uncle. Aren't these yin? Baby ghosts. The kind people trap with black magic, feed with blood, that turn on you if you ever stop.

z5s4_hiB_a.text: Come and find me. Nobody ever comes.
